name: Economy log: what a cache or container gives is logged with the cache it came from
contract: With the economy log on, every item a cache or container gives writes one cache_open row for the character who opened it, with the item, its count and the cache's entry as source, whether it lands in the bags or is mailed because the bags are full.

Champion's Battlegear - Experience Heirloom Cache (1339054, item_ethereal_set_cache) holds x3 Heirloom Weapon Token 414010, x2 Swift Hand of Justice 1642991, Champion's Deathdealer Breastplate 1648677 and Champion Herod's Shoulder 1642950: seven unstackable items; with four free slots the breastplate and the shoulder are mailed.
The Ethereal Tool Dispenser Crate (8263511, item_ethereal_lost_cache) has one reward, the Ethereal Tool Dispenser (8263501).
The Sentinel Basic Care Package (19150) opens a loot window with 20 Warsong Gulch Field Rations (19062) at 100%.
